title: AWS AI-DLC Workflows adds structure and approval gates to coding agents
friendlyTitle: AWS shares a step-by-step workflow for AI coding agents
summary: AWS Labs' AI-DLC Workflows, with about 4,300 stars, was a fast-moving AI repository in today's GitHub trends. It supplies adaptive workflow rules, lifecycle stages, audit records and human approval points for coding agents across supported harnesses.
friendlySummary: This project guides coding agents through planning, building, checking and human approval instead of letting them change software without structure.
whyItMatters: Software teams can use it as a starting point for turning an open-ended coding prompt into staged requirements, design, implementation and review work. Adapt the process to the project's risk and size; extra gates help on consequential changes but can burden small, reversible tasks.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can make larger AI coding jobs easier to review and audit. Use fewer steps for small, low-risk changes so the process does not become heavy.
